# PDF Quick Tools

> Browser-based PDF tools: compress, merge, split, convert, edit, sign,
> organize, and a set of AI tools that read a document you choose. Regular
> PDF operations run entirely in the visitor's browser and the file is never
> uploaded. AI tools are the exception: extracted text (or page images for
> scanned PDFs) is sent to the AI provider only when the visitor runs an AI
> action. No account is required.

Every tool is listed below with its own page. There are 58 tool pages.

## Start here

- [All tools](https://pdfpilot.site/tools): the complete catalogue, filterable by category.
- [Daily challenge](https://pdfpilot.site/daily-challenge): one suggested PDF task per day.
- [Study mode](https://pdfpilot.site/study-mode): turn one PDF into notes, a quiz, flashcards, or a summary.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://pdfpilot.site/privacy): what is and is not collected, and why.
- [Terms of use](https://pdfpilot.site/terms).
- [About](https://pdfpilot.site/about) and [contact](https://pdfpilot.site/contact).

## Tools

- [PDF Workflow](https://pdfpilot.site/pdf-workflow): Compress and number a PDF in one guided run.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size while keeping good quality.
- [Compress PDF to Exact Size](https://pdfpilot.site/compress-pdf-to-specific-size): Shrink a PDF to fit a specific KB or MB limit.
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/split-pdf): Extract selected pages from your PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfpilot.site/pdf-to-jpg): Turn PDF pages into JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/jpg-to-pdf): Turn JPG and PNG images into one PDF.
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/rotate-pdf): Turn pages 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
- [Rearrange PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/rearrange-pdf-pages): Drag pages into the order you need.
- [Delete Pages](https://pdfpilot.site/delete-pdf-pages): Remove pages you no longer need.
- [Extract Pages](https://pdfpilot.site/extract-pdf-pages): Keep only the pages you select.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://pdfpilot.site/add-page-numbers): Place clear page numbers exactly where you want them.
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/watermark-pdf): Stamp a custom text watermark onto selected pages.
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/sign-pdf): Draw your signature and place it on selected pages.
- [AI Summarizer](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-summarizer): Get an AI summary of any PDF.
- [AI Chat](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-chat): Ask questions about your PDF content.
- [Multi-PDF AI Chat](https://pdfpilot.site/multi-pdf-chat): Ask questions across several PDFs at once, with sources.
- [AI Quiz Generator](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-quiz): Generate quizzes from your PDF content.
- [AI Study Mode](https://pdfpilot.site/study-mode): One upload, four ways to revise it.
- [AI Notes Generator](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-notes): Turn your PDF into structured notes.
- [AI PDF Translator](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-pdf-translator): Translate PDF text while keeping its structure clear.
- [AI PDF Rewriter](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-pdf-rewriter): Rewrite PDF text for clarity, tone or length.
- [AI Ask PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-ask-pdf): Ask follow-up questions about one PDF in a focused chat.
- [AI PDF to Presentation](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-pdf-to-presentation): Turn a PDF into a structured presentation outline.
- [AI Flashcard Generator](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-flashcard-generator): Create study flashcards from your PDF content.
- [AI Citation Generator](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-citation-generator): Create APA, MLA, Chicago or Harvard citations from a PDF.
- [AI Grammar & Writing Checker](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-grammar-checker): Find grammar, spelling, clarity and repetition issues.
- [AI Document Analyzer](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-document-analyzer): Extract topics, dates, entities, sections and useful facts.
- [AI Resume Analyzer](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-resume-analyzer): Review resume content, structure and job-description alignment.
- [AI PDF Question Generator](https://pdfpilot.site/ai-pdf-question-generator): Generate document-grounded questions at three difficulty levels.
- [Crop PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/crop-pdf): Trim the edges off PDF pages.
- [Change Page Size](https://pdfpilot.site/change-page-size): Switch PDF pages between A4, Letter and Legal.
- [Flatten PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/flatten-pdf): Lock form fields and annotations into the page.
- [Grayscale PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/grayscale-pdf): Convert PDF pages to black and white.
- [Remove PDF Metadata](https://pdfpilot.site/remove-pdf-metadata): Strip author, software and date details from a PDF.
- [Extract Text from PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/extract-pdf-text): Pull the text out of your PDF into a .txt file.
- [Insert Blank Page](https://pdfpilot.site/insert-blank-page): Add empty pages at the end or after each page.
- [Header and Footer](https://pdfpilot.site/add-header-footer): Add a line of text to the top or bottom of pages.
- [Fill PDF Form](https://pdfpilot.site/fill-pdf-form): Fill in text fields and check boxes.
- [Redact PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/redact-pdf): Cover sensitive text with black boxes.
- [Highlight PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/highlight-pdf): Mark text in yellow, green, blue or pink.
- [Embed File in PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/embed-file-in-pdf): Pack extra files inside your PDF.
- [Add Bookmarks to PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/add-pdf-bookmarks): Add a table of contents to the PDF.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://pdfpilot.site/pdf-to-markdown): Turn a PDF's text into clean Markdown.
- [Compare PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/compare-pdf): See exactly what changed between two PDFs.
- [Edit PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/edit-pdf): Add your own text onto a PDF page.
- [Repair PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/repair-pdf): Rebuild a damaged or broken PDF.
- [Protect PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/protect-pdf): Add a password and lock a PDF.
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/unlock-pdf): Remove a password you know.
- [OCR PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/ocr-pdf): Make scanned PDFs searchable.
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/word-to-pdf): Turn a Word document into a PDF.
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfpilot.site/pdf-to-word): Make a PDF editable in Word.
- [PDF to Excel](https://pdfpilot.site/pdf-to-excel): Pull tables out of a PDF into a spreadsheet.
- [Excel to PDF](https://pdfpilot.site/excel-to-pdf): Turn a spreadsheet into a PDF.
- [PDF to PNG](https://pdfpilot.site/pdf-to-png): Save PDF pages as lossless PNG images.
- [Image to Text](https://pdfpilot.site/image-to-text): Read the text out of a photo or scan.
- [Create PDF Form](https://pdfpilot.site/create-pdf-form): Place fillable text boxes and checkboxes on your PDF.
- [Request PDF Signature](https://pdfpilot.site/request-signature): Email a PDF to a signer and track its progress.
